name: medilocker
description: MediLocker — Sovereign Digital Medical Records Vault with Medi-AI

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run preview"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
